title: Quality Director
text:
**Job Title:** Quality Director

**FLSA:** Full-Time, Exempt

**Department:** Quality (Assurance (QA) and Control (QC))

**Reports To:** President

**Has Direct Reports:** Yes

 

**Summary**

The Director of Quality will lead the development and execution of a comprehensive quality strategy that spans all functions of the manufacturing operations. This role is responsible for ensuring organizational compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and customer specifications, while promoting a culture of quality excellence, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement. In addition to providing strategic oversight of quality assurance, quality control, compliance, and regulatory activities, the Director will serve as the senior quality authority in cross-functional collaborations and executive-level decision-making. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in chemical manufacturing and regulatory compliance, particularly in ISO, GMP, EPA and OSHA; and demonstrate a proven ability to build, lead, and scale high-performing quality organizations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

1) Develop and implement the company’s quality vision, strategy, and systems to support operational objectives and business growth.

2) Ensure full compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 9001, cGMP, EPA, OSHA, REACH) and all relevant customer, industry, and statutory standards.

3) Oversee quality assurance, quality control, regulatory affairs, document control, and audit readiness across all manufacturing sites.

4) Lead the development and enforcement of quality policies, procedures, and performance metrics.

5) Manage internal and external audits and serve as the primary point of contact for regulatory agencies and customer quality assessments.

6) Drive investigation and resolution of critical quality issues, non-conformances, deviations, and customer complaints through root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) programs.

7) Establish and monitor quality KPIs to ensure consistent product quality, process capability, and continuous improvement.

8) Collaborate with cross-functional leadership (Operations, R&D, EHS, Supply Chain) to ensure quality is embedded throughout the product lifecycle.

9) Lead and mentor quality teams across multiple locations; develop organizational capabilities through structured training and talent development.

10) Provide regular quality performance updates and strategic insights to senior leadership.

11) Support new product introductions, process validation, and change control programs.

 

**Education and/or Experience**

1) Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, quality management, microbiology or a related field is required.

2) Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or Six Sigma Black Belt are strongly preferred.

3) Minimum of 10 years of progressive quality leadership experience, with at least five years in a senior management role within the chemical or process manufacturing industry.

4) Proven experience managing regulatory inspections, customer audits, and third-party certification processes.

5) Strong background in quality management systems (QMS), regulatory compliance, and risk management in a regulated environment.

6) Multi-site leadership experience is a plus.

 

**Additional Skills**

1) Deep knowledge of ISO 9001, cGMP, ICH Q7/Q10, and chemical industry-specific regulations (EPA, OSHA, REACH, TSCA).

2) Expertise in statistical process control (SPC), root cause analysis, CAPA, and quality risk management.

3) Strong strategic planning, analytical thinking, and decision-making capabilities.

4) Demonstrated success in leading change, driving process improvements, and fostering a quality-driven culture.

5) Excellent interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills.

6) Proficiency in quality software tools, ERP systems (e.g., SAP), and data reporting platforms.
